description: Get everything the catalog says about one activity by id: titles in English and Vietnamese, age bands, minutes, the app's step-by-step wording, reps or seconds per age band where the app defines them, and the area's grown-up tips with their sources. Use ids returned by list_activities. Read-only and free of personal data.

id.description: Activity id from list_activities, for example hero.frog-jumps or piano-song.hot-cross-buns.

name: get_activity

age_bands.description: Age bands (3-4, 5-6, 7-9) the activity is made for.

id.description: Stable activity id, usable with get_activity and how_to_teach.

minutes_basis.description: computed = from reps x tempo; app-stated = a number the app states; estimate = a planning estimate, not a measurement.

needs_grown_up.description: True when the app's own notes ask a grown-up to be nearby or to join in.

source.description: Repo path the activity was read from.

steps.description: The app's own step-by-step wording, when the catalog has it.

title: Get one BetterKids activity
